LVGLab 0.9.0 adds a search, a randomizer for screenshots and a screenshot export.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64), installer | `LVGLab-0.9.0-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows 10/11 (x64), portable | `LVGLab-0.9.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.9.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.9.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.9.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

The Windows installer adds a Start menu entry and can associate `.lvglab` files. The archives need no
installation: unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows). Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## New

- **Search** (Ctrl+F or Edit > Find): finds widgets by name or type and also property values, local styles
  (colors, fonts, images), events and flags across all screens and components. Several words narrow the result;
  a click opens the screen and selects the widget.
- **Screenshot export** (File menu, or `--export-screenshots <folder>` on the command line): saves a PNG of every
  screen at the resolution of the display, with transparent corners for round displays.
- **Randomizer** (dice button on the canvas, Shift for all screens): sets plausible random values on arcs, bars,
  sliders, switches, lists, charts and numbers in labels and tables, so screenshots do not show default values.
- New app icon.

## Fixed

- Start page: the close buttons are larger and square.
